Pod events bind the mechanism verbatim: Warning Unhealthy x10 over 82s 'Readiness probe failed: Get "http://172.20.2.91:8080/": net/http: HTTP/1.x transport connection broken: malformed HTTP response "\x00\x00\x1e\x04..."' - the port answered with HTTP/2 (gRPC) frames because the server speaks gRPC. Deployment config confirms the break: readinessProbe httpGet path / port 8080 against a gRPC server, while livenessProbe correctly uses grpc port 8080, and the Service port is itself named 'grpc' (port 5000 -> targetPort 8080). Consequence closed: Deployment emailservice READY 0/1 AVAILABLE 0, Endpoints of Service emailservice empty, and caller checkoutservice logs 26 errors 'failed to send order confirmation ... dial tcp 10.68.215.195:5000: connect: connection refused'. Application error logs are clean, so the fault is on the probe/health-check surface.
